boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Detroit Mercy recurring ceremonies, gatherings and recognitions spanning campus, athletics, service and Detroit Mercy Law.

cards.title: Open the year at Celebrate Spirit!
cards.subtitle: Mass of the Holy Spirit · McNichols Campus
cards.notes: Check the year’s University Ministry listing, then attend or observe this university-wide welcome that renews the community’s mission and values.
cards.short_summary: Detroit Mercy’s official welcome to a new academic year centers on its Mass of the Holy Spirit.
cards.evidence_claim: Detroit Mercy identifies Celebrate Spirit! as a university-wide celebration, official welcome to the academic year and part of its Mass of the Holy Spirit tradition.
cards.source_title: Celebrate Spirit! | University of Detroit Mercy
cards.access_notes: Dates and format vary by academic year; consult University Ministry’s current event information.

cards.title: Process into Commencement Mass
cards.subtitle: Baccalaureate Mass · Student Union Ballroom
cards.notes: Graduates can join the cap-and-gown procession; guests of all faiths are invited to this integral part of Detroit Mercy commencement.
cards.short_summary: Detroit Mercy holds a Baccalaureate Mass alongside graduation, with graduates processing in together.
cards.evidence_claim: Detroit Mercy describes its Commencement Mass as an integral commencement activity and says graduates process into the Mass together in cap and gown.
cards.source_title: Commencement Day | University of Detroit Mercy
cards.access_notes: Held in conjunction with commencement; the university says guests of all faiths are invited.

cards.title: Applaud Honors Convocation
cards.subtitle: Annual academic and leadership recognition
cards.notes: Look for the annual convocation and support honorees as Detroit Mercy recognizes student academic achievement, leadership and community service.
cards.short_summary: This annual university recognition brings students, families and campus community together around student accomplishments.
cards.evidence_claim: Detroit Mercy Libraries documents Honors Convocation as an annual event recognizing Detroit Mercy students’ academic excellence and leadership.
cards.source_title: Honors Convocation | University of Detroit Mercy Libraries
cards.access_notes: Held annually; the Honors Program handbook states that Honors Convocation is held in March.

cards.title: Mark the legal year at Red Mass
cards.subtitle: Detroit Mercy Law · Saints Peter and Paul Jesuit Church
cards.notes: Follow Detroit Mercy Law’s events calendar for this historic legal-community Mass, which asks for the Holy Spirit’s blessing on the year’s work.
cards.short_summary: The law school’s Red Mass continues a practice connected to Detroit College’s opening year.
cards.evidence_claim: A Detroit Mercy Law publication states that the school has hosted the Red Mass on behalf of the Archdiocese of Detroit every year since the Law School opened in 1912.
cards.access_notes: This is a religious observance; confirm the current year’s schedule with Detroit Mercy Law or the Archdiocese.

cards.title: Hear the McElroy Lecture
cards.subtitle: Detroit Mercy Law annual lecture
cards.notes: Watch Detroit Mercy Law’s event listings for the yearly forum, then attend to hear a featured thinker address law-and-religion questions.
cards.short_summary: Detroit Mercy Law presents an annual public forum focused on fundamental questions of law and religion.
cards.evidence_claim: Detroit Mercy Law states that the McElroy Lecture on Law & Religion is an annual event it presents every year.
cards.access_notes: Annual event; check Detroit Mercy Law’s current events information for the speaker, date and attendance details.

cards.entity_name: Dewitt C. Holbrook Lecture on Social Justice
cards.title: Attend the Holbrook social-justice lecture
cards.subtitle: Detroit Mercy Law annual lecture
cards.notes: Check the law school’s current event notices and attend this annual forum featuring legal leaders on social-justice law and policy.
cards.short_summary: The Holbrook Lecture is Detroit Mercy Law’s recurring forum for legal and policy discussion on social justice.
cards.evidence_claim: Detroit Mercy Law states that the Dewitt C. Holbrook Lecture on Social Justice is an annual event it presents every year.
cards.access_notes: Annual event; verify the current schedule, speaker and venue through Detroit Mercy Law.

cards.entity_name: Detroit Mercy Sports Hall of Fame Induction
cards.title: Recognize Titans in the Hall of Fame
cards.subtitle: Titan Club presentation
cards.notes: Follow Titan Athletics announcements for induction details and learn how Detroit Mercy formally recognizes athletes, coaches and administrators.
cards.short_summary: Detroit Mercy’s Sports Hall of Fame has honored major contributors to Titan Athletics since 1977.
cards.evidence_claim: Detroit Mercy Athletics says its Sports Hall of Fame, established in 1977, honors student-athletes, coaches and administrators who developed Titan Athletics.
cards.source_title: 12 New Titans Inducted Into Detroit Mercy Hall Of Fame | Detroit Mercy Athletics
cards.access_notes: The 2026 induction ceremony was held in the Student Union Building’s University Ballroom; future details vary.

cards.entity_name: Detroit Mercy Titans Cross Country Invitational
cards.title: Follow the Titan Invitational
cards.subtitle: Titan cross country’s long-running meet
cards.notes: Check the cross country schedule for the next edition, then support runners at a meet Detroit Mercy calls its longest-running Titan tradition.
cards.short_summary: The Titan cross country invitational began as a women’s collegiate race in 1987 and added a men’s race in 1988.
cards.evidence_claim: Detroit Mercy Athletics calls the Titans Cross Country Invitational the longest-running tradition in Titan history and dates its first race to 1987.
cards.source_title: BSN SPORTS To Sponsor Cross Country Invitational | Detroit Mercy Athletics
cards.access_notes: Meet location, entries and spectator arrangements vary by season; consult Detroit Mercy Athletics’ current schedule.

cards.title: Join UDM Street Fest
cards.subtitle: Annual community celebration · McNichols Campus
cards.notes: Watch Campus Connection for the next Street Fest, then spend the afternoon with campus and neighborhood partners at family-oriented activities.
cards.short_summary: UDM Street Fest convenes students, neighbors and local organizations around the histories near Six Mile and Livernois.
cards.evidence_claim: Detroit Mercy describes UDM Street Fest as an annual, community-centered event bringing together students, neighbors, local organizations and partners.
cards.source_title: UDM Street Fest | Detroit Mercy Campus Connection
cards.access_notes: The 2026 listing places the event on the McNichols Campus front lawn; verify the current date and activities.

cards.title: Take part in Day of Service
cards.subtitle: Annual Detroit Mercy community service day
cards.notes: Look for the annual service-day announcement, choose an available project and work alongside Detroit Mercy community members and local residents.
cards.short_summary: Detroit Mercy’s service day uses a Saturday to connect the university community with neighborhood improvement work.
cards.evidence_claim: Detroit Mercy Campus Connection describes the Detroit Mercy Day of Service as an annual event that brings the community together to improve the neighborhood and connect with residents.
cards.source_title: Service Learning | Detroit Mercy Campus Connection
cards.access_notes: Project locations and participation instructions vary annually; consult the current Detroit Mercy service-learning announcement.
